question: Should Google Meet attendance CSV intentionally prefix formula-like values with a literal apostrophe, accepting that downstream CSV consumers see a changed cell value?
rationale: The patch correctly closes the spreadsheet-formula sink, but safety requires an observable serialization change that cannot be resolved by CI or contributor proof alone.

options.title: Accept safe CSV serialization
options.body: Merge the focused change and treat apostrophe-prefixed formula-like cells as the supported CSV contract while JSON preserves exact raw values.

options.title: Redesign the CSV contract
options.body: Pause the PR and specify another spreadsheet-safe representation if exact CSV round-tripping is a stronger requirement.

recommendation.title: Accept safe CSV serialization
recommendation.body: Merge the focused change and treat apostrophe-prefixed formula-like cells as the supported CSV contract while JSON preserves exact raw values.

likelyOwner.reason: The attendance command and its CSV export path appear to originate from their Google Meet feature work.
